description: An interactive field guide to NASA's DART mission and planetary defence: why Chelyabinsk-size asteroids matter, how a 579 kg spacecraft hitting Dimorphos at 6.1 km/s shortened its 11.9-hour orbit by 33 minutes, why the ejecta pushed harder than the spacecraft, how years of warning turn millimetres per second into a miss, and ESA's Hera follow-up.
og: A 579 kg spacecraft, a 151 m moonlet and a 33-minute change: DART's test of asteroid deflection, with impact-energy, momentum and warning-time calculators.
brand: IMPACT — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
